translation: Took place in posad Serock, 19 September 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Berek Kołtun, laborer, 65, and Szlama [unclear: Kuraker/Kutas], trader, 47, both residing in Serock, and declared that yesterday at 6 PM in the village of Zegrze died a male infant without a name, [surname unclear: Kutnowski/Kuchnowski], six days of age, son of Jankiel and [unclear: Perla/Serla], nee unknown. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of the child this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the first witness is illiterate.
